source.title: Tin Ore — original Allakhazam commenter recounts 100 ore / 20 prospect attempts
source.author: Allakhazam (historical commenter; author name not retained)

notes: Original first-person 100-Tin-Ore prospecting cohort explicitly says 20 prospect attempts and output item totals. 100 ore / five per operation agrees with the reported 20. Completed casts are reported, but per-output positive-cast counts, zero-outcome counts, individual stack quantities, skill, specialization and client build are unknown; never derive hits or histograms. Do not combine with similarly mirrored Allakhazam comments on other Wowhead editions.

source.author: Psynister

notes: Independent 2011 published guide table reports 38% for prospecting this item from Tin Ore and a shown result stack range of 1–2. This is a source-supported guide/model prior, NOT a measured cohort; sample size, exact game build, observed min/max, hit counts, zeros and denominator provenance were not published. Keep separate from the firsthand Allakhazam 20-prospect study and other guides that copy the same reference table.
